question: Does the horizon-limited absolute response Psi_H, which bounds worst-case loss for signed (contrarian) kernels, measure risk where the margin did not?
universe_rule: ASCII alphanumeric Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals absent from every text file of the repository at the time of drawing, which must be after S1_universe.json is committed (enforced by the gate); klines on 2025-01-04 and 2026-09-23; 40 drawn in a seeded random order (seed 20261109); written to R1_universe.json before any data are downloaded
valid_day: C3's rule; evaluable symbol: at least 200 valid days; void if fewer than 20 evaluable
estimates: from the 20 valid days before t within 30 calendar days: C3's price equation (kappa, beta) and 12-lag flow kernel k; h_1 = kappa, h_{n+1} = (1+beta) h_n + kappa sum_m k_m h_{n-m}; Psi_H = sum_{n<=H}|h_n|, H = 12; ex-ante shock = mean daily standard deviation of five-minute taker flow over the 20 days; instrument = log Psi_H from days t-40..t-21
primary_1: 2SLS, symbol fixed effects, next-day log(1+MAE) on log Psi_H instrumented by its lag, controlling for the log ex-ante shock, standard errors clustered by date: elasticity positive with one-sided p < 0.05
primary_2: F1's pooled out-of-sample design with log Psi_H (winsorized) as regressor for next-day log(1+MAE): coefficient positive and one-sided Clark-West p (differentials averaged within dates) < 0.05
primary_3: Primary 2 with the winsorized margin added to both models: coefficient on log Psi_H positive and p < 0.05
correction: Holm across the three primaries at 0.05
secondary: P1 with log S = log(kappa/M) (Pilot 7's regression on new symbols) and with log|S_H|
P1 in symbols with negative and with positive median kappa*Phi; log S in momentum symbols
S1's stress-day rule: mean partial Spearman between log Psi_H and log(1+MAE)

readings.all_pass: the certified worst-case-loss measure forecasts losses beyond volatility and beyond the margin: certification from public data is informative about risk once the right functional is certified
readings.P1_fails: losses do not scale with the estimated absolute response; the linear closed-loop model does not describe the size of daily moves in these markets
readings.P2_passes_P3_fails: the information in Psi_H is shared with the margin
